sources.inspection_note: ModuleNotFoundError; FileNotFoundError; KeyError; IndexError; SyntaxError; IndentationError; TabError — Read each listed class and conditions. sources.title: Two-item zero-based index example
sources.details: For the explicit animals=["貓","狗"], execution returns 貓 at 0 and 狗 at 1 and len=2. A nonnegative scalar index i is valid exactly for 0 <= i < 2; i=2 corresponds to ordinal i+1=3 and fails with IndexError. An out-of-range slice [2:] is a separate operation and returns [] as the official exception documentation specifies.
